vachanas.kannada:
ವಚನಾರ್ಥವನರಿದು ನುಡಿದಿಹೆನೆಂದಡೆ,
ರಚನೆಯ ರಂಜನೆಗೆ  ಒಳಗಾಯಿತ್ತು.
ತತ್ವವನಟ್ಟೈಸಿಹೆನೆಂದಡೆ
ಆತ್ಮಘಾತಕ ಭೂತಸಿದ್ಧಿಗೊಳಗಾಯಿತ್ತು.
ಸರ್ವವೂ ತಾನೆಂದರಿದವಗೆ ಸಂದೇಹಸೂತಕವಿಲ್ಲ.
ಅರಿವು ಆತ್ಮನಲ್ಲಿ ವೇದ್ಯವಾದವಗೆ
ಆ ಸರ್ವವೂ ಅಹುದಲ್ಲಾಯೆಂದು ನಿಂದ ಮತ್ತೆ
ಮಾರ್ಪೊಳಲನೇರಿದ ಧೀರನಂತಿರಬೇಡವೆ ಪರಮವಿರಕ್ತಿ.
ಲೋಲಿಯ......ದಂತೆ, ಜೋಲಿಯ ಕೀಲಿನಂತೆ
ಗ್ರಂಥಿಯ ಗಸಣದಂತಿಪ್ಪವರ ಕಂಡೆನಗೆ ಹೇಸಿಕೆಯಾಯಿತ್ತು.
ಪರತತ್ವಪ್ರಕಾಶ ಚೆನ್ನ ರಾಮೇಶ್ವರಲಿಂಗವನರಿವುದಕ್ಕೆ
ಅಹುದೋ, ಅಲ್ಲವೋ ಎನುತಿರ್ದೆನು.
vachanas.transliteration:
vacanārthavanaridu nuḍidihenendaḍe,
racaneya ran̄janege  oḷagāyittu.
tatvavanaṭṭaisihenendaḍe
ātmaghātaka bhūtasid'dhigoḷagāyittu.
sarvavū tānendaridavage sandēhasūtakavilla.
arivu ātmanalli vēdyavādavage
ā sarvavū ahudallāyendu ninda matte
mārpoḷalanērida dhīranantirabēḍave paramavirakti.
lōliya......dante, jōliya kīlinante
granthiya gasaṇadantippavara kaṇḍenage hēsikeyāyittu.
paratatvaprakāśa cenna rāmēśvaraliṅgavanarivudakke
ahudō, allavō enutirdenu.
vachanas.translation:
If I say, "I have spoken after knowing the meaning of the vachana,"
It has merely become an embellishment of literary composition.
If I say, "I have expounded the Truth,"
It has become self-destruction and a display of bhuta siddhi - occult attainments.
For the one who has realized that all is the Self, there is no impurity born of doubt.
For the one to whom Knowledge has become directly realized in the Self,
Do not, after denying everything as "This is not That," become like a warrior who turns back in retreat, O Supreme Renunciate.
Seeing those who are like a fickle pendulum... and like the loose pin of a swing,
Or like a knot worn thin by constant rubbing, I was filled with disgust.
As I sought to realize Paratattva-prakāśa Cenna Rāmeśvaraliṅga,
I remained asking, "Is it so, or is it not?"
